facts.fact: The NRB, per its Principal Secretary, is the only department mandated to register births, deaths, marriages and citizens aged 16+ for national IDs, so one body holds both registers.
The Principal Secretary says the National Registration Act of 2010 mandates the NRB to run the national registration and identification system.

The Principal Secretary says the law makes the Malawi Electoral Commission recognise the national ID as the single source of truth for voter registration, after Parliament made it the only proof of identity.
The Principal Secretary says children under 16 get birth registration certificates with a unique identification number, over three million so far.
